product.title: Miami Raccoon Island Adventure
product.description: Explore Biscayne Bay on a family-friendly wildlife cruise to Raccoon Island near Miami. Cruise routes include shoreline views, opportunities to spot marine wildlife, and an island stop where guests can explore and enjoy shallow-water swim time.
highlights: Shared wildlife cruise through Biscayne Bay
Island stop at Raccoon Island with optional guided walk
Possible sightings include raccoons, dolphins, and manatees
Swim stop in shallow water with floating mat access
Scenic pass by Indian Creek Island

meetingPoint.name: Aqua Party Boat - Pier 3, Venetian Marina

itineraryItems.title: Biscayne Bay cruise
itineraryItems.description: Depart Venetian Marina and cruise through Biscayne Bay while viewing Miami shoreline scenery.

itineraryItems.title: Raccoon Island stop
itineraryItems.description: Step ashore for optional guided wildlife viewing and beach time.

itineraryItems.title: Indian Creek Island pass-by
itineraryItems.description: Cruise past Indian Creek Island on the return route.

additionalInfo: Paid and free parking options are available near Venetian Marina

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from?
faqs.answer: The meeting point is Aqua Party Boat at Pier 3, Venetian Marina, 1635 N Bayshore Dr in Miami.

faqs.question: How long is the Raccoon Island adventure?
faqs.answer: The listed tour duration is approximately 3 hours 30 minutes.

faqs.question: What wildlife might be seen on the route?
faqs.answer: The route may include opportunities to spot raccoons on the island plus dolphins and manatees in Biscayne Bay.

faqs.question: Is there time to swim?
faqs.answer: Yes. The experience includes a shallow-water swim stop with floating mats.
